questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT?
questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT?

options.html: Acid formers consist of aerobic bacteria
options.text: Acid formers consist of aerobic bacteria

options.html: Methane formers consist of strict anaerobic bacteria
options.text: Methane formers consist of strict anaerobic bacteria

options.html: Acid formers solublize organic solids through hydrolysis
options.text: Acid formers solublize organic solids through hydrolysis

options.html: Methane formers consist of facultative and anaerobic bacteria
options.text: Methane formers consist of facultative and anaerobic bacteria

questions.explanationHtml:
(b, c)
Acid formers consist of facultative and anaerobic bacteria and include organisms that solubilize
the organic solids through hydrolysis.
Methane formers consist of strict anaerobic bacteria.

questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following is incorrect about sanitary landfilling?
questions.questionText: Which of the following is incorrect about sanitary landfilling?

options.html: It is also known as controlled tipping.
options.text: It is also known as controlled tipping.

options.html: Waste is stablised by aerobic process alone.
options.text: Waste is stablised by aerobic process alone.

options.html: Refuse is dumped into low lying areas.
options.text: Refuse is dumped into low lying areas.

options.html: Filling of refuse is carried out by dividing the area into smaller portions called cells.
options.text: Filling of refuse is carried out by dividing the area into smaller portions called cells.

questions.explanationHtml:
(b)
Initial waste decomposition may involve aerobic processes but the majority of waste stablization in landfills occurs through anaerobic processes due to lack of oxygen in deeper layers of landfill.
